title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows: shared meeting timer from the room console
summary: The briefing accurately reports the planned room-console timer, its January CY2027 target and the roadmap's Teams Rooms Pro licence condition. Microsoft's published Pro price matches the briefing; targeted searches found no documentation for this timer's admin switch, default, rollout prerequisites or audit activity.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; What's changing; Why it matters; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated what this timer does on arrival, so its default state is unknown.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Windows meeting countdown timer default admin setting; "Teams Rooms" "timer". Read roadmap, mtr-home-refresh, rooms-release-note; no default for this timer. Facilitator agenda timers are a different feature.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn does not yet describe the standalone room-console meeting timer.
claims.quote: Searched: "Teams Rooms" "timer"; Teams Rooms Windows meeting countdown timer. Opened mtr-home-refresh, rooms-release-note, facilitator-teams-rooms; the last describes a distinct Facilitator agenda timer, not console start/pause/resume/cancel.

claims.where: controls[0]; summary; Risk assessment; Governance controls; Open questions
